title: feat(plugin-sharing,plugin-approvals,metadata-protocol)!: 18.x step 7 part 7a-3 — the organization-less readers of sharing rules, approval units and the seed loader retire
body:
Part of #24583 — step 7, part 7a-3 (claim 6285134534; governing text: execution record 6285122667, ADR-0131 D2 and D8). The other step-7 parts (7a-1 driver, 7a-2 authz, 7b-*, 7c webhooks) are not in this PR, and #24583 remains open.

Clause-②: yes (narrowing): a declared sharing rule served under `single` gains the `deploymentWide: true` key on the wire in place of `organization_id: null` (widening); the sharing-rule admin reads, the approval unit screen and the scoped seed pre-load stop reading rows with no organization (narrowing). A declared rule keeps applying deployment-wide; nothing an author declares is refused.

## What changes

**plugin-sharing `sharing-rule-service.ts`**
- A declared rule's `single` projection carries a typed marker, `deploymentWide: true` (`DeploymentWideSharingRule`, `isDeploymentWideSharingRule`), and no `organization_id` key. This is the shape of the declared webhooks' `deploymentWide` (ruling A, 6278609968). The scope list holds a `DEPLOYMENT_WIDE_SCOPE` symbol in place of `null`.
- `criteriaContext` loses its NULL branch. It answers one of three named cases:
  - the rule's organization, which is the tenant predicate;
  - a deployment-wide projection, which carries no tenant (D8 computes no predicate under `single`);
  - a composition with no organization object (the lean embedding, `no-organization-object`), which also carries no tenant.
  - Otherwise it answers `null`: a stored row with no organization sweeps nothing and grants nothing, and the service logs it once at `error` with the remedy.
- **How the sweep runs (decided and pinned):**
  - Under `single`: one deployment-wide pass, and each grant is stamped with its record's organization.
  - Under a wall: one projection per organization, each inside that organization's one predicate, with grants stamped with it. No projection carries the marker under a wall, so Layer 0's predicate is never widened.
- `adminOrgScope` and `findRuleRowByName` read the caller's own organization only.
- `assertCanDeletePlatformGlobalRule` is deleted, together with its call.
- `sweepOrphanedRuleGrants` and `ruleGrantScope` follow the marker.

**plugin-approvals `ApprovalService.businessUnitOrgScope`**: a strict equality. The ceremony attributes `sys_business_unit`, and a fresh install stamps it.

**metadata-protocol `seed-loader.ts`**: the `unownedHolders` read is deleted, together with its `refuse` decision and the refusal text #24681 had rewritten. A scoped load issues no `organization_id IS NULL` read on any path.

**Pins rewritten to the new rule** (no assertion weakened):
- `rule-criteria-org-scope.test.ts` (real SqlDriver):
  - declared rule under `single`: deployment-wide sweep;
  - declared rule under `isolated`: per-organization sweep;
  - stored org-less row: refused, logged once;
  - lean embedding: the control case.
- `sharing-rule.test.ts`:
  - #7676 / #7761 / #8158 blocks: own-organization only;
  - the #7795 platform-global delete block is removed with its guard;
  - declared single projection: carries the marker.
- `approval-service.test.ts` and `business-unit-member-org-screen.test.ts` (fixtures re-stamped to the request's organization).
- `seed-loader-null-organization-holder.test.ts` and its runtime real-driver twin (no NULL read on any of the three readers).
- The two sharing dogfood files.

## Premise measured first (step 7's "after certification")

Every reader retired here was dead on all three trees:

| tree | tenant-column tables | rows with NULL `organization_id` |
|---|---|---|
| certified database (`ceremoniedFixture` over the 18.0 fixture), after the ceremony and again after a HEAD boot | 66 | 0 |
| fresh birth-marked `single` install (showcase `--fresh`) | all | 0 (`sys_business_unit` 5 rows, all stamped) |
| fresh `isolated` install, real organizations runtime | all | 0 |

One live path remains. It is kept, not deleted: the lean embedding with no organization object, which still writes NULL rows by design. It keeps the deployment-wide sweep, keyed on the composition fact (`sys_organization` not registered), never on a row's NULL. The production `os serve` boot without `OS_AUTH_SECRET` is that same composition today; 7b-3 makes it refuse.

## Proof

Final head `357025dc97`. The boots, harness and suites ran on `62227f5632`, which differs from it only by `main`'s README commit.

- **R1:** a fresh showcase boot on a random port, run on the pre-merge head and again on the final head:
  - health 200, seeded-admin sign-in 200, 0 error lines;
  - 0 NULL `organization_id` rows in any tenant table;
  - the declared rule `share_key_account_qualified_contacts_with_managers` materialised a stamped grant.
- **R2 + R3:** `upgrade-18x-harness.dogfood.test.ts` + `organization-ownership-boot-refusal-order.dogfood.test.ts` passed, together with the two sharing dogfood files: 33/33. This run includes the ceremonied fixture, and the v17 refusal fired before the ceremony.
- **R4:**
  - An `isolated` `os serve` with `@objectstack/organizations` (invite-only membership, owner email set), on both heads: health 200, sign-in 200, 0 error lines, 0 NULL rows. `GET /sharing/rules` serves both declared rules as per-organization projections, with no marker. The grant is stamped.
  - Step 4's 7 walled e2e cases (`serve-organizations-host-resolution` + `serve-organizations-mount-failure`, `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`): 7/7.
- **Suites:**
  - plugin-sharing 51 files / 1181 tests;
  - plugin-approvals 86 / 1147;
  - metadata-protocol 251 / 20815;
  - runtime 431 / 6781;
  - typecheck of plugin-sharing, plugin-approvals, metadata-protocol, runtime and dogfood: exit 0.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` on the 12 code paths derived 75 commands. All 75 ran, and every exit code was captured before any pipe.
  - 73 exited 0 on the first run.
  - `check-system-context-census` was red: `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` still cited the deleted `assertCanDeletePlatformGlobalRule`. The citation was dropped, and the re-run exited 0.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` was a shallow-clone artefact: its pinned fixture commit was absent. It exited 0 once that commit was fetched.
  - Re-derived on the final 15 paths (1,641 changed lines, under the 3,000 line): the 26 newly derived docs families plus the 15 ratchet and test-reading families, 41 commands, all exit 0.
- **More pins the suites found, rewritten:**
  - `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts`: the served declared shape now carries the marker.
  - `sharing-rule-positions-name-authority.test.ts`: retitled. Its delete case is refused by the scope gate, not by the retired guard.
- **A sweep of 11 more candidate files, all green:**
  - 7 dogfood files (scope-depth ×3, BU projection, BU/user delete, single platform insert, single-tenant identity create);
  - the cli declared-rule-mirrors integration test;
  - the rest canonical-query-AST test;
  - the cloud-connection posture-gate test.
- **Ablation** of the main pin: restoring the NULL branch (`return SYSTEM_CTX` for every org-less rule) turned exactly the two predicted cases red ("a STORED rule with NO organization …", whole-rule and per-record), and the other 6 stayed green. Restore was proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- `main`'s `recipient-membership-recompute.ts` (`ruleReadsRowsOf`, landed in `0b7286ff`) still reads `rule.organization_id == null` as "reads every row". With the marker the deployment-wide projection has no `organization_id`, so it is still counted as affected, which is the right answer. The spelling is a NULL-shaped reader outside this part's file surface.
- `sharing-plugin.ts`'s `resolveDeclaredRuleScopes` still spells `single` as `[null]`. `setDeclaredRuleScopes` translates it at that one door, so no NULL travels past it. Retyping the plugin side is outside the claimed surface.
- `approval-service.ts` `teamIsProvablyOutsideOrg` keeps its "no organization ⇒ leave routing" limb (a team screen). It is not in this part's surface, and its doc cross-reference was corrected.
- The ORG-STAMPED pin in `rule-criteria-org-scope.test.ts` still expects `deal_p1` through the driver's NULL record arm. That is 7a-1's arm and 7a-1's pin. Separately, an org-less RECORD matched by two walled projections aborts the second pass with `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`. That case cannot occur on a certified database, and it goes away with 7a-1.
- File surface: beyond the claim's list, this PR edits one hand-written docs page (`content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, row 40: the deleted guard's citation, which its census gate requires) and pins in `packages/runtime` and `packages/qa/dogfood`. It touches no `docs/adr/**` and no `content/docs/releases/`.
- The seed pin files keep their `null-organization-holder` names: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` registers them by path.
